== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The World of Night is a specialized technique utilized by [[Akura Malice]]. This domain is constructed from nightmares and shadows, characterized by a thick atmosphere of darkness and dreams that can inflict terror upon the spirit of those within it. As a technique, it serves as [[Malice]]'s primary method for interacting with [[Fate]] and observing shadows of the future. The environment can manifest various forms, such as smoky statues or specific silhouettes like a dragon, a tiger with a halo, a shelled warrior, and a bird. While it can be activated consciously, it has also been known to trigger involuntarily, plunging the user into a pitch-black domain. Although [[Malice]] can exit this realm, her memories of the experience persist.}}
